description: This script is a command-line tool written in Python that renders PlantUML `.puml` files into PNG images by communicating with a PlantUML server. It handles argument parsing, file traversal, HTTP requests, and parallel processing for rendering multiple files efficiently.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Immutable data class encapsulating all configuration options for the script, such as directories, server URL, timeout, retries, jobs, and output formatting.

methods.name: int _positive_int(value: str)
methods.description: Converts a string to a positive integer, raising an error if invalid.

methods.name: int _non_negative_int(value: str)
methods.description: Converts a string to a non-negative integer, raising an error if invalid.

methods.name: str _encode_6bit(value: int)
methods.description: Encodes an integer (0-63) into a URL-safe character for PlantUML encoding.

methods.name: str _append_3bytes(b1: int, b2: int, b3: int)
methods.description: Encodes three bytes into four PlantUML-specific characters.

methods.name: str deflate_and_encode(text: str)
methods.description: Compresses the input text with zlib, then encodes it into PlantUML format for URL transmission.

methods.name: str _normalize_server_url(server_url: str)
methods.description: Strips and verifies the server URL, ensuring it starts with http:// or https://.

methods.name: Iterable[pathlib.Path] _iter_puml_files(base_dir: pathlib.Path, max_depth: int)
methods.description: Walks through directories up to a specified depth to find `.puml` files.

methods.name: pathlib.Path _target_path( source_path: pathlib.Path, input_dir: pathlib.Path, output_dir: pathlib.Path, flatten_output: bool, )
methods.description: Calculates the output path for a given source file, respecting the flatten option.

methods.name: None _validate_target_collisions(jobs: Sequence[Tuple[pathlib.Path, pathlib.Path]])
methods.description: Ensures no two source files produce the same output path, raises an error if collisions are found.

methods.name: bytes _fetch_png(url: str, timeout_seconds: int, retries: int, retry_delay_seconds: float)
methods.description: Requests a PNG image from the PlantUML server, with retries and error handling.

methods.name: None _atomic_write_bytes(target_path: pathlib.Path, content: bytes)
methods.description: Writes bytes atomically to the target path using a temporary file.

methods.name: None _render_single(job: Tuple[pathlib.Path, pathlib.Path], config: Config)
methods.description: Handles rendering of a single `.puml` file into a PNG by encoding and fetching from server.

methods.name: Config _parse_args(argv: Sequence[str])
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a Config object, validating inputs.

methods.name: int main(argv: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None)
methods.description: Main entry point, orchestrating the parsing, file collection, rendering, and error handling.

ctags.name: _append_3bytes
ctags.pattern: /^def _append_3bytes(b1: int, b2: int, b3: int) -> str:$/

ctags.name: _fetch_png
ctags.pattern: /^def _fetch_png(url: str, timeout_seconds: int, retries: int, retry_delay_seconds: float) -> byte/
ctags.signature: (url: str, timeout_seconds: int, retries: int, retry_delay_seconds: float)

ctags.name: _target_path
ctags.signature: ( source_path: pathlib.Path, input_dir: pathlib.Path, output_dir: pathlib.Path, flatten_output: bool, )
